notes.title: First update for the First Toy - Sequel Releasing Soon!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We’re excited to share a small update for Don’t Be Afraid - The First Toy, aimed at improving things that will polish this already nerve-wrecking prologue while you await some truly BIG news! The game has received a few technical tweaks, ensuring a smoother and more immersive dive into the dark, psychological thriller you've come to know and love.

But what we want you to really know about is... the SEQUEL! 🕵️‍♂️

That’s right—the terrifying sequel to Don’t Be Afraid is on its way and releasing very soon. If you thought the first game gave you chills, you haven't seen anything yet. Expect a deeper story, new mechanics, and even more terrifying environments as we expand on the universe you've already braved. The next chapter will unravel more about the mysteries surrounding David and his dark past.

What’s in this update?


 Added Don't Be Afraid 2 wishlist button in Main Menu
 Changed the ending of the game to connect with the upcoming sequel
 Added bag pickup sound
 Improved the position and scale of some objects
 Increased the resolution of some textures
 Added visual changes to the UI

Stay Tuned for the Sequel!
Mark your calendars and keep an eye on our announcements—Don’t Be Afraid 2 will be dropping soon. Get ready for a whole new level of fear and suspense. More details, including the official release date and trailers, will be revealed soon, so make sure you're following our Steam page to stay updated!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2631880/Dont_Be_Afraid_2/

In the meantime, feel free to dive back into Don’t Be Afraid and its prologue to relieve the nightmares that will recur in the sequel! We can’t wait for you to experience the next terrifying installment.

Stay scared,
The Don’t Be Afraid Team

notes.title: A.I.D. Artificial Intelligence Defence - New game from Hydra Games

Dear Players,

We would like to introduce you to our new project "A.I.D. Artificial Intelligence Defence" 

A.I.D. Artificial Intelligence Defense is a tactical tower defense RTS with extremely dynamic gameplay.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37751759/6c2dd4bc9b71053360d026e3f3a229457a86d78e.png
Lead the operations of an advanced artificial intelligence program with only one aim – to clear the Earth from the remains of humanity
Develop technology, extend your base, expand and increase your abilities to complete the task
Devise new solutions, improve and produce new combat units
Design and create a net of defences and fortifications which will assure the security of your central unit
Collect data, spy on your enemy, broaden your knowledge 
Formulate the best strategies for combat and operations
Play alone or with friends 


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31496194/23dd2e719aa7339758963ebcfef208b7988398c5.gif

Lead the operations of an artificial intelligence program with only one aim – to clear the Earth from the remains of humanity. Conquer the world campaigning on a single-player dynamic battleground or play with your friends during a real time strategic gameplay.

This will be our first Multiplayer game! 

Check out the game trailer:

[previewyoutube=KNyjusN61c0;full][/previewyoutube]

This fragment is from my (game's author's) private notes:

“We wanted to create a game where the story would be based on the fight between humanity and advanced artificial intelligence. Something that can happen in the future. Due to rapid and uncontrolled development of the technologies artificial intelligence will become self-aware. We wanted to tell players a story in which the artificial intelligence recognizes humanity as the greatest threat to the planet and decides to remove it”


We love the whole Terminator universe and we want to give you a game in the climate we love. But made with our soul. We're going to give you a game where you can finally play the bad guys! 
Using Terminator terminology, imagine what it would be like to play Skynet…


If you like this project and want to support us, add it to your wishlist and hit the “Follow” button! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31496194/d20c6f73439256fba2c7c2b6f6b98b37f6d1b454.gif

Write in the comments what you think about this game! we are interested in your opinion!

Best regards! 
Hydra Games Team!

notes.title: Don't Be Afraid - The nightmare has begun
notes.content:
Hello, everyone!

Shh.. be quiet someone is here, Oh look, a tape? Maybe we should listen to it!

[previewyoutube=GVrWpsFOJJ8;full][/previewyoutube]

We are in the basement now, it looks dirty and awful, well that doesn't matter. Today, the "Don't Be Afraid" nightmare has begun and nothing can stop it. The game is now available for purchase on Steam.


It was a long way to get to this moment, after lots and lots of hard work and time which was put into it. As you can see at our socials, we always want to deliver the best content we can and not just a final game. We hope that our activity on social media platforms helped engage the community into the horror mood. Now here we are, go ahead and check out our steam page to get your copy today.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/760410

Watch the launch trailer prepared for this day:

[previewyoutube=hdVwnQtlWl0;full][previewyoutube=qvGgx1O1YIA;full][previewyoutube=2mZ0jN9KP8I;full][/previewyoutube][/previewyoutube][/previewyoutube]

You’ve been kidnapped by a child killer and placed in a house filled with puzzles. Try to break the system, escape, and end the nightmare.

Your name is David, you are 11 years old... and this is the end of your innocent childhood.

You have woken up in a dark, cold room. Despite the darkness, you are trying to recognize the surroundings, but in vain. You don't know, where you are. Frightening sounds can be heard all around you, the feeling of helplessness fills in your soul. You are too afraid to walk alone in this terrifying space... but you have to.

Your memories are slowly coming back. You remember a strange man... in a mask. Did he kidnap you? Where is your torturer? The fear of unknown drives you to actions. You are desperately trying to find the way out of this nightmare.

The worst part of this story is the fact, that someone always keeps an eye on you. And this person finds watching you very entertaining.

Remember, the fate of a victim is sealed once it is in the hands of a sadistic psychopath.
If you want to survive, grow up. Quickly.


Limo Games and Hydra Games
